'''Count Dooku's ''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer''' was a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] that served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war it served as [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] flagship.

==History==
[[File:Dookuchair-CrisisattheHeart.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Providence''-class carrier served as the personal flagship of Count Dooku]]
This ship was seen orbiting deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] near [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. Count Dooku was seated inside his ship when a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]], [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]] and a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] approached and informed him about the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] plan to send supplies to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Later during the battle, TX-20 was transferred from Dooku's ship to Ryloth below. Later on in the war, it traveled to Toydaria to retrieve [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] after he captured [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]]. TX-20 was replaced by [[Kraken/Legends|Kraken]] as the commanding officer of the ship.

The ship participated in the [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|invasion of Scipio]], as part of the Separatist invasion fleet. Numerous fighters and bombers were deployed to [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]] to attack the Republic garrison. The Republic countered the Separatists with a massive armada, and Dooku's fleet retreated.
